Anthropic discloses an accuracy gain against a different baseline on selected questions. This is company-reported context, not an independent finding or a refutation of shrinking gains elsewhere.

reviews.rationale: One format-dependent regression does not establish numerous credible signs of diminishing gains. The packet lacks multiple matched historical series; Anthropic's different comparison also does not disprove their existence.

A dated user report identifies incorrect factual self-description in the exact snapshot and describes reproduction. It is neither independently replicated nor an OpenAI acknowledgment.

reviews.rationale: Release-week testing documents coding failures, and a contemporaneous report documents incorrect factual self-description in the named snapshot. Together they support persistence of errors, without establishing frequency or regression in general reliability.

reviews.rationale: Close coding results provide limited support, while Arena reports show advantages that depend on baseline and domain. Without the graph or sufficiently broad comparable measurements, neither convergence without a decisive leader nor its opposite is established.
